data.name: Mods_UsumExpansion_Name
data.value: Ultra Sun & Ultra Moon Pokémon Expansion

data.name: Mods_UsumExpansion_Author
data.value: Aqua, improved by the community

data.name: Mods_UsumExpansion_Description
data.value: Adds the Pokémon of Generations 8 and 9 to Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon, raising the 807 species the games ship with to 1025, with their moves, abilities and items. It does not edit fields: it replaces whole files (an expanded personal table, the moves, the game texts) and the game's code.bin. Pokemanager does not distribute it: the Download button fetches the files from the author's own release into your library. It has known faults worth reading before a run.

data.name: Mods_UsumExpansion_Issue_Learnsets
data.value: The learnsets of Generations 1 to 7 do not include the new moves.

data.name: Mods_UsumExpansion_Issue_UpperHand
data.value: Upper Hand works with any move, not only with the ones it should.

data.name: Mods_UsumExpansion_Issue_Baxcalibur
data.value: Baxcalibur's model is out of place in the summary screen.

data.name: Mods_UsumExpansion_Models
data.value: The model archive a/0/9/4 is distributed apart from the repository because of its size (2.3 GB), and it holds models taken from the Switch games: the CC0 the mod declares covers the mod's own work and not somebody else's copyright, so nothing of it is ever shipped with Pokemanager. The download button fetches it from the author's own Google Drive link, the one the repository's description points at. Google changes that download page without notice: when it stops working, open the link yourself and add the file with the Import button.

data.name: Mods_Follower_Name
data.value: Pokemon Follower Mod (Includes SM)

data.name: Mods_Follower_Author
data.value: Aqua_

data.name: Mods_Follower_Description
data.value: Your lead Pokémon walks behind you around the map, with an in-game menu on Start+Select. It is a 3GX plugin the emulator loads beside the game, not a change to the ROM: it has no romfs, no exefs and no code.bin, so nothing is packed and no build is needed — installing it copies one file into your emulator's plugin folder, and removing it takes that file back out. Pokemanager distributes none of it: the file comes from the author's own GameBanana page into your own library, like your ROMs.

data.name: Mods_Follower_Issue_FormCycling
data.value: Cycling forms with L+A is, in the author's own words, “very experimental and prone to crashes”, and their FAQ says it is broken. It can freeze or close the game.

data.name: Mods_Follower_Issue_Untested
data.value: Not every species, form and map could be tested, so unusual combinations can give graphical faults or hang the game.

data.name: Mods_Follower_Issue_OldHardware
data.value: On an older 3DS the Lite mode animates at 5 interpolated frames a second, which makes the Pokémon look like it is sliding rather than walking.

data.name: Mods_Follower_Issue_FlyingHeight
data.value: Some flying Pokémon float at an odd height, because their animations are built differently from the rest.

data.name: Mods_Follower_Issue_NoPokemon
data.value: If the plugin's menu appears but no Pokémon ever does, that is a fault the author acknowledges and has not patched yet.

data.name: Mods_Follower_Setup
data.value: Switch on the 3GX plugin loader in your emulator, or nothing at all will happen and the mod will look broken. In Azahar it is Emulation > Configure > System. Pokemanager cannot switch it on for you.

data.name: Mods_Follower_Conflict_OnePlugin
data.value: Only one 3GX plugin is loaded per game. If another .3gx is already in that folder, this one will not load — the card says which files it found there.

data.name: Mods_Follower_Conflict_LayeredFs
data.value: Coming from the old LayeredFS version of this mod: delete FieldRo.cro and FieldDebug.cro, and — only if you installed that package — .crr/static.crr.

data.name: Mods_Follower_Conflict_Expansion
data.value: With the USUM Expansion Mod: compatible from version 3.1 onwards, the release that added that support (earlier ones froze). The two also disagree on the game version — the Expansion requires USUM 1.0 USA, while the follower accepts an unpatched game and 1.2 — so running both means being on USUM 1.0.

data.name: Mods_LicenseDisagrees
data.value: The author declares a different licence depending on where you look: {0}. Pokemanager does not choose between them — both are the author's own words, in different places.

data.name: Mods_UsumExpansion_Summary
data.value: Adds the Pokémon of generations 8 and 9 to Ultra Sun and Ultra Moon, with their moves, abilities and items.

data.name: Mods_Follower_Summary
data.value: The first Pokémon of your team follows you around the map. It is an emulator plugin: it is installed, not built into the ROM.
